cards.mood: The piece opens with a brooding, mysterious atmosphere that feels ritualistic and restrained.
cards.palette: A heavily distorted electric guitar serves as the core harmonic driver, entering subtly in the verses and exploding into a dense, rhythmic wall of sound during the choruses.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Copper veins pulse beneath the stone
Shadows stretch where the light is thrown
A hollow hum vibrates in the air
The gears of time grind in a snare
[Pre-Chorus]
Iron lungs breathe in the dust
Steel and marrow turn into rust
[Chorus]
Break the silence of the grinding wheel
Forge the spirit in the furnace zeal
Fragments of the old world fall away
Chaos finds its voice in shades of gray
[Verse]
Glass vials hold the secrets of the deep
Awake from a long and heavy sleep
Monsters dance in the laboratory halls
Echoes rise against the crumbling walls
[Pre-Chorus]
Iron lungs breathe in the dust
Steel and marrow turn into rust
[Chorus]
Break the silence of the grinding wheel
Forge the spirit in the furnace zeal
Fragments of the old world fall away
Chaos finds its voice in shades of gray
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The clockwork heart begins to race
Order yields to a jagged space
[Chorus]
Break the silence of the grinding wheel
Forge the spirit in the furnace zeal
Fragments of the old world fall away
Chaos finds its voice in shades of gray
[Outro]
